title: The Cousin
writer: Massimo Franciosa, Luisa Montagnana, Ercole Patti
actors: Massimo Ranieri, Dayle Haddon, Christian De Sica
plot: A strong plot and mutual physical attraction binds the sensual Enzo since adolescence and her cousin Agata: the two are happy with amusement tricks erotic equivocally poised between innocence and malice instinctive.
